description: isometric pixel art building for a fantasy village builder game, bright vivid saturated colours, crisp dark outlines, a single isolated object on a plain background, part of a stone stronghold at the edge of a forest, standing directly on bare ground with no ground tile, base or platform under it, the greenhouse at its grandest: a large glass house with a tall glass dome in the middle on curved wooden ribs over a grey stone base, inside lush herb beds with many coloured flowers, climbing vines and small trees in pots, a little stone fountain, watering cans and baskets of herbs by the door, the glass panes catching the light

references.usage: the first, smallest stage of this same building, chosen by the author: keep its stone, timber, roof colours, outlines and pixel style, and draw the bigger, richer next stage of it
